behavior.arguments: rdi = destination base; rsi = minuend base (rewritten in place); rdx = subtrahend base. Four 64-bit limbs are read at [rsi+0x00..0x18] and [rdx+0x00..0x18]; four difference limbs are written at [rdi+0x00..0x18] and one borrow-out byte at [rdi+0x20]. No other argument is read and no other field is written.

edges.borrow: with minuend [0, 0, 0, 0] and subtrahend [1, 0, 0, 0] the destination is [0xffffffffffffffff, 0xffffffffffffffff, 0xffffffffffffffff, 0xffffffffffffffff] and the borrow-out byte is 1.
edges.borrow_chain: with minuend [0, 1, 0, 0] and subtrahend [1, 0, 0, 0] the destination is [0xffffffffffffffff, 0, 0, 0] and the borrow-out byte is 0: the limb-1 value absorbs the borrow.
edges.full_minus_one: with minuend [0xffffffffffffffff, 0xffffffffffffffff, 0xffffffffffffffff, 0xffffffffffffffff] and subtrahend [1, 0, 0, 0] the destination is [0xfffffffffffffffe, 0xffffffffffffffff, 0xffffffffffffffff, 0xffffffffffffffff] and the borrow-out byte is 0.
edges.no_borrow: with minuend [1, 0, 0, 0] and subtrahend [0, 0, 0, 0] the destination is [1, 0, 0, 0] and the borrow-out byte is 0.
edges.zero: with minuend and subtrahend all 0 the destination is all 0 and the borrow-out byte is 0.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with mov (%rdx),%rax (NOT endbr64); zero branches, zero calls inside; a single ret.
behavior.return_rule: limb0 = [rsi+0x00] - [rdx+0x00]; limb1 = [rsi+0x08] - [rdx+0x08] - borrow0; limb2 = [rsi+0x10] - [rdx+0x10] - borrow1 (sub/sbb chain); limb3 = [rsi+0x18] - [rdx+0x18] - borrow2, where borrow2 is applied via the add-$0xff borrow-in trick (add $0xff,%cl sets CF iff the limb-2 borrow was 1, then sbb $0,%rax subtracts it). The borrow-out byte at [rdi+0x20] is (limb-3 sub borrow) OR (limb-3 sbb borrow), masked to 0/1. [rsi] is rewritten in place with the four difference limbs, and the copy to [rdi] is UNCONDITIONAL — no branch gates it.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; exactly two sites found, both inside the single caller FDE [0x3299180, 0x32996b6), each boundary-confirmed by linear disassembly from that FDE start. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: No R_X86_64_RELATIVE record in any .rela.* section names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
